name: Take Care Of It.
source:
Austin and Riley are childhood friends. Despite their tumultuous friendship in high school, things are going pretty good now in college.

But that stability does not last.

Something happens. Old habits resurface.

Riley can fall back into old patterns, or he can draw a line.

Both choices leave marks.

Play as Riley as he grapples with guilt, responsibility, and personal limits.

[From [url=https://zealli.itch.io/take-care-of-it]itch.io[/url]]
